newsitem.title: USA: Youth Services sees $6 mln gain on sale.
newsitem.headline: Youth Services sees $6 mln gain on sale.

text.p: Youth Services International Inc said Wednesday it expects to record a $6 million pre-tax gain on the $21.7 million sale of its behavioral health services unit.
Youth Services said it has entered a definitive agreement for Austin, Texas-based Youth and Family Centered Services Inc to buy the business for cash.

Youth and Family -- owned primarily by a private equity firm based in Atlanta called Cravey, Green and Whalen -- will also acquire the stock of all Youth Services' units that conduct its behavioral health programs, Youth Services said.
The transaction is expected to close near the end of September, it said.
The company previously announced plans to dispose of the unit and in March recorded a $27 million restructuring charge associated with the decision.
